Sanitized Grok Build session fixture.

Shape covered:
- Official `sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<session-id>/summary.json` metadata layout.
- Authoritative ACP `updates.jsonl` records with user, agent, thought, tool, and hook updates.
- Unix-second update timestamps and session-level model metadata.
- User-facing `_meta.displayText` selection.

No real prompts, account data, project names, tokens, file contents, tool output, or local user paths are included.
